title: Aranya data freshness
description: Every value Aranya displays carries a Freshness record so the UI can state when data was observed, retrieved, and how stale it is now. Freshness is never inferred; if it is unknown it is null, not guessed.

as_of.description: The time the observation itself describes (e.g. forecast valid time, or the trading day of a mandi price). Null when the provider does not state it. NOT the retrieval time.

retrieved_at.description: UTC instant Aranya received the value. Null only for values that were never retrieved (for example a user-entered manual reading, which instead sets manual_entry_at).

manual_entry_at.description: Set instead of retrieved_at when a human typed the value, e.g. a farmer entering their own Soil Health Card result.

provider.description: Stable source id from data/sources.yml. Null for manual or derived values.

expected_refresh_interval.description: ISO-8601 duration after which the value should be considered stale, e.g. P1D. Chosen per data category, not per provider marketing claim.

state.description: Derived from as_of/retrieved_at versus expected_refresh_interval. 'unknown' when no timestamp is available and must be shown to the user rather than hidden.

partial.description: True when this record covers only part of the requested spatial or temporal extent, so the UI must not imply completeness.
